designations.eng: Compressed gaseous fuel measuring systems for vehicles
designations.fra: Ensembles de mesurage de gaz compressé pour vehicules

eng: Compressed gaseous fuel measuring systems for vehicles

terms.designation: Compressed gaseous fuel measuring systems for vehicles

definitions.content: Measuring system intended for the refueling of motor vehicles with compressed gaseous fuel. Such an instrument is hereafter called a "measuring system".

terms.designation: Ensembles de mesurage de gaz compressé pour vehicules

definitions.content: Ensembles de mesurage destinés au ravitaillement des véhicules à moteur en gaz compressé. Ces instruments sont appelés par la suite « ensembles de mesurage ».
